summary: 40-foot L-4 pole tower on the Kaniksu National Forest, Bonner County, built 1934 and abandoned in the 1950s; a 2022 post found only three footings.

facts.design: 40-foot pole tower with L-4 cab; crow's-nest tree platform about 1 mile southeast
facts.status_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts found three footings and nothing else at the site, in a post dated August 8, 2022.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts classes the site as drive-up, but its team had to bushwhack through vegetation to find the footings.

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 1934 build, L-4 design and 1950s abandonment. The 2022 Idaho Fire Lookouts post is the only physical description of the site. Staffing: no staff list found; the 1945 self-portrait is the only person-at-site detail and comes from a blog post describing a photo, not from a staffing record. No photos added: the image source and license were not confirmed. Crow's-nest platform's fate is not described by any source.
